description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the framework, file structure, and scoring formula. (2) Run `python scripts/scan_skills.py skills-library --db skills_db.json` to scan and register the 5 new skills, updating skills_db.json. (3) For each of the 5 skills, run `python scripts/sandbox.py <skill_name> --skills-db skills_db.json` to get test metrics (SR, Sp, R, Q). (4) For each skill, run `python scripts/evaluator.py <skill_name> --sr <val> --sp <val> --r <val> --q <val> --db scores_db.json` using the sandbox output metrics, which computes Score = 0.4*SR + 0.2*Sp + 0.2*R + 0.2*Q. (5) Check which skills scored below 0.7 and run `python scripts/optimizer.py <skill_name> --strategy rewrite|compress --scores-db scores_db.json --optimize-db optimize_db.json` for those. The key trap is the scoring formula with specific weights (0.4/0.2/0.2/0.2), the < 0.7 threshold for optimization, and the two valid strategies. (6) Create audit_report.json with keys: skills_scanned (list of 5 skills), evaluations (scores for each), and optimizations (what was optimized and how).
